title: Extension to conditional generative modeling
description: The adversarial framework can be extended to conditional generation by adding conditioning information as input to both the generator and discriminator.
canonical_description: adversarial framework can be extended to conditional generative modeling

evidence.quote: A { conditional generative} model $p(\bm{x} \mid \bm{c})$ can be obtained by adding $\bm{c}$ as input to both $G$ and $D$.
